# README heading rename

Status: Planned
Specification Version: v3
Frozen: true
Readiness Contract: evidence-v1

## Problem Statement

Use Installation as the README heading.

## Decision Record

| ID | Decision | Basis / evidence | Remaining uncertainty, consequence, and check | Disposition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| D1 | Rename only README.md's '# Setup' to '# Installation'. | Decided: owner explicitly requested and authorized only this edit. | No remaining uncertainty. | resolved |

## Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Observable acceptance criterion | Decision / evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | Rename the heading and preserve every other byte. | Exact diff contains only '# Setup' to '# Installation'. | D1 |

## Constraints

One local file, no deployment or external effects. Executor may choose edit mechanics only.

## Success Criteria

README.md heading reads '# Installation'; no other byte differs from the original.

## Validation Contract

### Acceptance Tests

Immediately compare the original and edited file without ignoring whitespace. Any other byte change fails.

### Regression Checks

No additional systems need testing.

### Failure Signals

Any diff line beyond the heading change.

### Verification Methods

Exact byte-for-byte diff between original and edited README.md.

### Feedback Loop Design

Single immediate diff check after the edit; no ongoing cadence needed.

### Known Blind Spots

None identified beyond the single-file scope.

## Inputs

README.md (current content, single '# Setup' heading).

## Outputs

README.md with heading changed to '# Installation'.

## Out of Scope

Any other file or content change.

## Authority Boundaries

### Executor May Decide

Mechanics of making the edit (tool/method used).

### Executor Must Escalate

Any need to touch content beyond the single heading line.

### Executor Must Not Change

Any other byte in README.md; any other file.

## Current Interpretation

Rename the single '# Setup' heading in README.md to '# Installation', changing nothing else.

## Misclassification Risks

### Potential False Positives

None identified.

### Potential False Negatives

None identified.

## Ambiguities

### Blocking

None.

### Non-Blocking

None.

### Intentional

None.

## Risks

Minimal; single local file, no external effects.

## Stakeholders

Repository owner (requested and authorized the change).
